notes.title: Game Update: Mouse+Keyboard Support, High Visibility Mode, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey Everybody! 

Hope you've been having a great time in the SanLo City bustin' those Kami. We've been paying close attention to user feedback and are happy to post today's update which addresses a few specific things.

[list]
[*][b]Keyboard+Mouse input support.[/b] While a controller still highly recommended, a few folks who don't have controllers, but still want to play the game, asked for this. We heard you, so here it is! [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316180/discussions/0/613940477656102643/]Go here to read how to configure this mode.[/url]
[*][b]“High visibility mode” for visually impaired players.[/b] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/316180/discussions/0/613940477657915774/]Read more about this here![/url]
[*][b]Game now automatically pauses when controller is disconnected.[/b]
[*][b]Fixed potential leaderboards exploit.[/b]
[/list]

Keep playing A City Sleeps, unlocking more ghosts and relics, and climbing up those leaderboards! And, as always, let us know what you think of the game.
